title: Decide: known kid inside 60s refetch interval after sub-60s freshness
description: From review of JMAP-atfj. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 §Key Publication allows caching only 'for the HTTP freshness lifetime' and forbids refetching one peer domain 'more often than once every 60 seconds'. When a peer's /.well-known/jmap is fresh for under 60 s (no-store, no Cache-Control, short max-age or DNS TTL), PeerKeys now rejects even a known kid until the interval ends (strict reading; peer usable on one request per minute). Alternatives for Mark: (a) keep strict reject; (b) serve the last result until the interval ends (deviates from the freshness cap); (c) amend the draft, e.g. treat freshness as at least 60 s or say what a receiver does in that window.
